text: LSODA, a default solver for many biological ODE systems in SciPy, automatically switches between the non-stiff Adams method and the stiff ___ method depending on detected stiffness.
explanation: LSODA (Livermore Solver for ODEs with Automatic method switching) toggles between the non-stiff Adams method and the stiff Backward Differentiation Formula (BDF) method as the character of the system changes during integration.
